$comment: Copy this file to config/local.json and adjust. It deep-merges over config/default.json. Example: Trading212 DEMO (practice) account with Finnhub real data and DeepSeek analysis. Run `pnpm migrate-config` after upgrading: it reports (and with --write applies) every key an older config still needs, e.g. the gate keys introduced with ADR 0012.

risk.$comment: Practice-account risk profile. maxHeatPct caps the TOTAL INVESTED fraction (heat = Sum(weight) x (1 - stopDistancePct)), NOT the risk per name: 0.2 blocks every BUY once ~30% of NAV is invested (ADR 0004). Match it to the allocation cash floor: (1 - minCashBuffer) x (1 - stopDistancePct) = 0.855 with the defaults.
